title: The Platypus Hunts With Its Eyes, Ears and Nose All Shut

scenes.text: The platypus hunts with its eyes, ears and nose all shut.
When it dives, it closes all three.
So it finds food with its bill, which has about forty thousand sensors.
They pick up the tiny electric signals from the muscles of shrimp and crayfish.
It sweeps its bill side to side and zaps in on dinner it can't see, hear or smell.
A hunter that finds food by electricity.

description:
The platypus closes its eyes, ears and nose when it dives and hunts with its bill alone.
The bill has about 40,000 sensors that pick up tiny electric signals from the muscles of prey.
Would you want this sixth sense?
first_comment: Would you rather have a platypus bill or an eagle's eyes?
